ops.sql: SELECT c.Connector_ID, c.ea_guid, c.Name, c.Connector_Type, c.Start_Object_ID, s.Name AS SrcName, c.End_Object_ID, e.Name AS TgtName FROM t_connector c INNER JOIN t_object s ON s.Object_ID = c.Start_Object_ID INNER JOIN t_object e ON e.Object_ID = c.End_Object_ID WHERE s.Package_ID IN (714,715,716) OR e.Package_ID IN (714,715,716)
